onboarding.languageHint: You can change this any time in settings.
onboarding.companionName: What would you like to call your companion?
onboarding.addressForm: In Tamil, how should it talk to you?
onboarding.caloriesQuestion: Do you want to see calorie numbers?
onboarding.caloriesHint: Many people feel better without numbers. Your food still gets a gentle balance score.
onboarding.lastPeriod: When did your last period start?
onboarding.lastPeriodHint: Pick a date or skip if you don't remember.
onboarding.cycleLength: How long is your cycle usually?
onboarding.medsHint: Add anything you take regularly, like metformin, inositol or vitamin D. You can add more later.
onboarding.notificationsHint: Only gentle reminders. Never more than 4 a day, and quiet at night.
onboarding.lockQuestion: Lock the app with your fingerprint, face or phone PIN?
onboarding.privacyBody: Your data is stored in your own private database. To reply, your companion sends short, anonymous context (never your name, email, phone or photos of you) to free AI models, some of whose providers may keep logs. Food photos are processed and deleted. You can export or delete everything any time.

chat.emptyBody: Tell me how your day is going, what you ate, or how you feel.
chat.crisisBody: If you're thinking about hurting yourself, please reach out now to someone you trust, or call Tele-MANAS, India's free mental health helpline. They speak Tamil too.

photo.title: What's on the plate?
photo.hint: Check the items. Edit or remove anything before saving.
photo.notFood: I couldn't spot food in that photo. Try another one?
photo.unavailable: Photo logging isn't available right now. You can type what you ate in chat.

today.title: Today
today.balanceEmpty: Nothing logged yet. Tell me what you ate in chat, or snap a photo.

ideas.add_protein: Idea: some dal, curd, egg or sundal could add protein
ideas.add_fiber: Idea: a poriyal or fruit adds easy fiber
ideas.add_veggies: Idea: a small bowl of kootu or poriyal
ideas.swap_low_gi: Idea: millets or brown rice now and then

cycle.title: Cycle
cycle.unknown: Log a period to start tracking
cycle.rangeNote: PCOS cycles often vary, so this is a range.
cycle.tapDay: Tap a day to log your period
cycle.historyEmpty: Your past cycles will show here.
cycle.autoClosed: We ended this period after 10 days. Did it end on {{date}}?
cycle.notDuringPeriod: That day is inside a logged period.

insightCards.delayBody: It's {{count}} days past the predicted range. That's common with PCOS.
insightCards.delayFactors: Things that may have played a role:
insightCards.delayPregnancy: If there's any chance of pregnancy, a home test is an easy way to rule it out.
insightCards.delayDoctor: If delays keep happening, your doctor can help.

factors.low_intake_days: Some days with lighter meals than your usual
factors.usual_pattern: Your cycles have been this long before

insightCards.redFlagTitle: Worth a chat with your doctor

redFlags.no_period_90: It's been 90 days or more since your last period.
redFlags.heavy_bleeding: You logged very heavy bleeding with strong pain.
redFlags.long_bleeding: A period lasted more than 8 days.
redFlags.intermenstrual_bleeding: You've had bleeding between periods on several days.
redFlags.severe_pelvic_pain: You logged severe pelvic pain outside your period.
redFlags.chat_symptom: Something you mentioned in chat is worth checking.

insightCards.redFlagBody: This isn't an emergency alert, just a gentle nudge to mention it to your doctor soon.

patterns.mood_by_phase: Your mood tends to dip a little in the {{phase}}.
patterns.cravings_luteal: Cravings show up more in the days before your period.
patterns.sugar_acne: Acne days sometimes follow higher-sugar days.

insights.title: Insights

insights.notEnough: Not enough data yet. Keep logging and this will fill in.
